The '''Imperial Economic Update''' was a news program that was broadcast on [[Imperial HoloVision]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Imperial Economics Advisor]] [[Adana Vermor]] hid information in the broadcast as part of her efforts to undermine the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] from her inside position. She provided [[infocapsule]]s to trusted groups which allowed them to decode the data.<ref name="ES">{{WEGCite|story=The Event of the Season|book=Tapani Sector Instant Adventures}}</ref>
